## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, high-quality 3D-style multiplayer gun game for mobile/tablet and PC, with guns, vehicles, helicopters, bases, and responsive low-lag gameplay.

## Requirements
- User requested: “high quality gun game g or Mobil and PC no lag and have any guns multi player game and cars gel copters bases and any that new gun games have (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)”.
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained, browser-playable top-down 2D arena shooter as a practical, lightweight prototype; multiplayer is represented by AI opponents and an AI fireteam.
- Chose Dustline as the sector map, with a relay capture objective, three weapon classes, a Ranger 4×4, and a Dust Hawk helicopter.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js` implementing the menu, arena, HUD, shooting, AI enemies, capture objective, weapons, pickups, grenade, vehicles, pause/win/lose flows, desktop keyboard/mouse input, and touch controls.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started a local HTTP server and opened the game in Playwright; page title was `Strikepoint: Redline`.
- Saved and inspected `/tmp/opencode/strikepoint-menu.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate gameplay in-browser, including deployment, shooting, capture, vehicles, responsive mobile layout, and errors; improve any defects found.
- No changes have been committed; `game.js`, `style.css`, and `index.html` are untracked.

### Blocked
- Real online multiplayer is not implemented; current opponents and squad are bots.
- The prototype is canvas-drawn 2D, not a full 3D game.
- Browser reported a missing `favicon.ico` (404), the only observed console error so far.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser checks by deploying with `playwright-cli`, capture the latest JPEG screenshot, and inspect the gameplay view.
2. Test the main controls and check desktop/mobile layouts and console output.
3. Consider adding a favicon or suppressing the 404, then summarize prototype limitations and launch instructions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, menus, and touch control markup.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive desktop/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Game loop, rendering, AI, combat, vehicles, objectives, and controls.
- `/tmp/opencode/strikepoint-menu.jpg`: Latest inspected menu screenshot.

## Important Context
- Local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; Playwright page is at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `playwright-cli open` succeeded after installing Chromium; `playwright-cli console error` showed only `favicon.ico` 404.
- Controls include WASD/mouse, `1`/`2`/`3` weapon swap, `R` reload, `E` vehicle enter/exit, `Q` grenade, and Escape pause; mobile uses touch sticks and action buttons.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, high-quality gun game for mobile/tablet and PC, with guns, vehicles, helicopters, bases, and responsive gameplay.

## Requirements
- User requested: “high quality gun game g or Mobil and PC no lag and have any guns multi player game and cars gel copters bases and any that new gun games have (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)”.
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Built **Strikepoint: Redline**, a lightweight, browser-playable top-down 2D arena shooter prototype.
- Uses AI opponents and an AI fireteam instead of online multiplayer; features the Dustline map, relay capture objective, three weapon classes, a Ranger 4×4, and a Dust Hawk helicopter.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js` with menu, HUD, arena rendering, combat, AI, capture objective, weapons, pickups, grenade, vehicles, pause/win/lose flows, desktop input, and touch controls.
- Fixed hidden overlay elements intercepting clicks with `[hidden]{display:none!important}`.
- Improved camera bounds, displayed the gameplay crosshair, and added a data-URI favicon.
- Validated desktop deployment, shooting, weapon switching, and Escape pause via Playwright. Desktop test: ammo fell from 30 to 28, weapon switched to KITE-45, pause activated.
- `node --check game.js` passed. A prior browser check reported zero console errors.

### Active
- Validate gameplay further, particularly vehicle access and mobile touch firing/layout.

### Blocked
- Real online multiplayer and true 3D rendering are not implemented; this is a single-player bot prototype rendered on a 2D canvas.
- Vehicle entry test has not succeeded; walking around the Ranger during a Playwright test did not reach it.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser testing vehicle proximity/entry/exit and mobile touch controls.
2. Investigate the failed vehicle approach test; test via direct in-game position or a more reliable control sequence.
3. Check browser console after real input interactions, then summarize launch instructions and prototype limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface, HUD, menus, and touch control markup.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive desktop/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Game loop, rendering, AI, combat, objectives, vehicles, and controls.
- `/tmp/opencode/strikepoint-gameplay.jpg`: Earlier gameplay screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/strikepoint-mobile.jpg`: Mobile viewport screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/strikepoint-vehicle-test.jpg`: Vehicle test screenshot.

## Important Context
- Local server is available at `http://localhost:3002`; started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Controls: WASD/mouse, `1`/`2`/`3` switch weapons, `R` reload, `E` vehicle enter/exit, `Q` grenade, Escape pause; mobile uses touch sticks and action buttons.
- A synthetic Playwright `dispatchEvent('pointerdown')` on `#fire-touch` produced `NotFoundError: Failed to execute 'setPointerCapture' on 'Element': No active pointer with the given id is found.` This was caused by synthetic dispatch lacking a real active pointer, not confirmed as a real touch-device defect.
- Changes are uncommitted; project game files are untracked.
